title: Rethinking Soft Tokens for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.37391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel generation by predicting and committing multiple tokens at each denoising step, yet they can generate individually plausible but mutually inconsistent tokens. Recent work shows that \emph{soft tokens} can mitigate this issue by representing uncertain positions with continuous embeddings built from the model's predictive distribution at the previous decoding step. However, although soft tokens are commonly understood as preserving predictive uncertainty, how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding has not been systematically examined. In this paper, we investigate this question in frozen pretrained DLMs to examine soft-token feedback without the effects of additional training. To construct soft-token inputs in a training-free setting, we identify a geometric mismatch between conventional soft-token construction and the pretrained embedding space. translated_title: 重新思考扩散语言模型中用于并行解码的软令牌
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）通过在每个去噪步骤中预测并确定多个令牌来实现并行生成，但它们可能生成各自看似合理却彼此不一致的令牌。最近的研究表明，软令牌可以缓解这一问题，其方法是在上一个解码步骤中利用模型预测分布构建连续嵌入来表示不确定的位置。然而，尽管软令牌通常被理解为保留预测不确定性，但软令牌反馈如何改善并行解码尚未得到系统性研究。在本文中，我们在冻结的预训练扩散语言模型中研究这一问题，以在不受额外训练影响的情况下检验软令牌反馈。为了在无需训练的设置下构建软令牌输入，我们识别了传统软令牌构建方式与预训练嵌入空间之间的几何失配。基于这一观察，我们提出了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文系统研究了软令牌反馈改善扩散语言模型并行解码的机制，在无需训练的设置下发现传统软令牌构建方式与预训练嵌入空间之间存在几何失配，并据此提出改进方法。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically examines how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding in frozen pretrained diffusion language models, identifying a geometric mismatch between conventional soft-token construction and the pretrained embedding space, and proposes a training-free method based on this observation.
